objectivesText: Speak to Myranda to gain the Scarlet Illusion. Travel to Hearthglen while under the Scarlet Illusion and deliver Tirion's Gift to Highlord Taelan Fordring.
Hearthglen is to the north, Taelan should be inside of Mardenholde Keep.

5863.name: The Dunemaul Compound
objectivesText: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.

5892.name: Irondeep Supplies
objectivesText: Bring 10 Irondeep Supplies to the Alliance Quartermaster in Dun Baldar.

5903.name: A Plague Upon Thee
objectivesText: Use the Empty Termite Jar on the Termite Mounds in Eastern Plaguelands. After you've gathered 100 Plagueland Termites, return to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

5904.name: A Plague Upon Thee
objectivesText: Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in Western Plaguelands to place the Barrel of Plagueland Termites.

5921.name: Moonglade
objectivesText: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

5923.name: Heeding the Call
objectivesText: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.

5924.name: Heeding the Call
objectivesText: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.

5925.name: Heeding the Call
objectivesText: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.

5929.name: Great Bear Spirit
objectivesText: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear. When finished, return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

5931.name: Back to Darnassus
objectivesText: Return to Darnassus and speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave.

5941.name: Return to Chromie
objectivesText: Take the Bundle of Relics to Chromie in Andorhal.

5942.name: Hidden Treasures
objectivesText: Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.

5943.name: Gizelton Caravan
objectivesText: Escort the Gizelton Caravan through Mannoroc Coven. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.

5944.name: In Dreams
objectivesText: Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.

5981.name: Rampaging Giants
objectivesText: Rivern Frostwind wants you to kill 4 Frostmaul Giants and 4 Frostmaul Preservers.

6001.name: Body and Heart
objectivesText: Use the Cenarion Moondust on the Moonkin Stone of Auberdine to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.
Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus when you are done.

6004.name: Unfinished Business
objectivesText: Kill 2 Scarlet Medics, 2 Scarlet Hunters, 2 Scarlet Magi and 2 Scarlet Knights before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

6021.name: Zaeldarr the Outcast
objectivesText: Bring Zaeldarr's Head to Caretaker Alen at Light's Hope Chapel.

6023.name: Unfinished Business
objectivesText: Kill Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen before returning to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

6024.name: Hameya's Plea
objectivesText: Kill Infiltrator Hameya. Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.

6025.name: Unfinished Business
objectivesText: Enter Hearthglen and find a high vantage point from which you can see the town and gauge the Scarlet Crusade's forces, then return to Kirsta Deepshadow in Western Plaguelands.

6026.name: That's Asking A Lot
objectivesText: Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars, 1 Golden Rod, 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs, and 8 Unstable Triggers.
You will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items.

6027.name: Book of the Ancients
objectivesText: Get the Book of the Ancients and return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.

6028.name: The Everlook Report
objectivesText: Deliver the Everlook Report to Argent Officer Pureheart at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

6030.name: Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff
objectivesText: Deliver the book, "Studies in Spirit Speaking", to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.

6031.name: Runecloth
objectivesText: Bring 30 Runecloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.

6032.name: Sacred Cloth
objectivesText: Bring 2 Mooncloth to Meilosh in Timbermaw Hold.

6041.name: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent
objectivesText: Travel to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's Hope. Destroy 8 Scourge Structures by using Smokey's Special Compound at the Mark of Detonation planted inside each building. Smokey has had the Ziggurats and Slaughterhouses marked.
Once you plant the bomb, leave the building and marvel at your handiwork.
By the way, Smokey's Special Compound is rather... unstable.

6063.name: Taming the Beast
objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Webwood Lurker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6064.name: Taming the Beast
objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Large Crag Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

6071.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6072.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6073.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6074.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

6075.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

6076.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

6084.name: Taming the Beast
objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Snow Leopard. Practice your skills, then return to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

6085.name: Taming the Beast
objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ice Claw Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.

6086.name: Training the Beast
objectivesText: Speak with Belia Thundergranite in Ironforge.

6101.name: Taming the Beast
objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Nightsaber Stalker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6102.name: Taming the Beast
objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Strigid Screecher. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6103.name: Training the Beast
objectivesText: Speak to Jocaste in the Cenarion Enclave, in Darnassus.

6121.name: Lessons Anew
objectivesText: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

6122.name: The Principal Source
objectivesText: Use the Empty Cliffspring Falls Sampler to draw a sample of water from the mouth of the cave by the falls.
Deliver the Filled Cliffspring Falls Sampler to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine, Darkshore.

6123.name: Gathering the Cure
objectivesText: Bring 5 Earthroot and 12 Lunar Funguses to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine so she may make a curative salve.

6124.name: Curing the Sick
objectivesText: Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Deer that are located throughout Darkshore; doing so should cure them. Sickly Deer have been reported starting south of the Cliffspring River to the north of Auberdine and extending all the way into southern Darkshore where the edge of Ashenvale begins.

6125.name: Power over Poison
objectivesText: Return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.

6132.name: Get Me Out of Here!
objectivesText: Escort Melizza Brimbuzzle, then speak with Hornizz Brimbuzzle at the Kodo Graveyard in Desolace.

6134.name: Ghost-o-plasm Round Up
objectivesText: Bring 8 Ghost-o-plasms and the Crate of Ghost Magnets to Hornizz Brimbuzzle in Desolace.

6141.name: Brother Anton
objectivesText: Speak with Brother Anton in Desolace.

6161.name: Claim Rackmore's Treasure!
objectivesText: Find Rackmore's Silver Key. Find Rackmore's Golden Key. Find and open Rackmore's Chest.

6164.name: Augustus' Receipt Book
objectivesText: Bring Augustus' Receipt Book to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.

6181.name: A Swift Message
objectivesText: Bring Lewis' Note to Thor the gryphon master.

6182.name: The First and the Last
objectivesText: Speak with Mathias Shaw in Old Town Stormwind. He resides in the Barracks.

6183.name: Honor the Dead
objectivesText: Speak with Mathias Shaw again if you wish to accept his task.

6184.name: Flint Shadowmore
objectivesText: Travel to Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands and meet up with your contact, Flint Shadowmore.

6185.name: The Eastern Plagues
objectivesText: Scour the Eastern Plaguelands for clues as to the "Blightcaller" and the missing SI:7 agents. If you find any SI:7 Insignias, return them to Flint Shadowmore at Chillwind Camp.

6186.name: The Blightcaller Cometh
objectivesText: Return to Stormwind and inform Highlord Bolvar Fordragon of the fate of Nathanos Marris.

6187.name: Order Must Be Restored
objectivesText: Assemble an army and travel to the Eastern Plaguelands. Launch a full assault on Nathanos Blightcaller and any Horde filth that may attempt to protect him.
Keep your wits about you, <Name>. The Horde will defend the ranger lord with their very lives.

6261.name: Dungar Longdrink
objectivesText: Bring Osric's Crate to Dungar Longdrink the gryphon master.

6281.name: Continue to Stormwind
objectivesText: Buy a gryphon ride from the gryphon master Thor, then bring Lewis' Note to Osric Strang, in the shop Limited Immunity, in the Old Town of Stormwind.

6285.name: Return to Lewis
objectivesText: Buy a gryphon ride to Sentinel Hill from the gryphon master Dungar Longdrink, then take Osric's Crate to Lewis at Sentinel Hill.

6341.name: The Bounty of Teldrassil
objectivesText: Bring Nessa's Collection to Vesprystus.

6342.name: Flight to Auberdine
objectivesText: Ride a hippogryph to Auberdine from the hippogryph master Vesprystus, then bring Nessa's Collection to Laird.

6343.name: Return to Nessa
objectivesText: Bring Laird's Response to Nessa Shadowsong.

6344.name: Nessa Shadowsong
objectivesText: Speak with Nessa Shadowsong.

6387.name: Honor Students
objectivesText: Bring Brock's List to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar.

6388.name: Gryth Thurden
objectivesText: Bring the Honorary Picks to Gryth Thurden in Ironforge.

6389.name: A Plague Upon Thee
objectivesText: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

6391.name: Ride to Ironforge
objectivesText: Buy a gryphon to Ironforge from the gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson, then bring Brock's List to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.

6392.name: Return to Brock
objectivesText: Buy a gryphon to Thelsamar from the gryphon master Gryth Thurden, then bring the Honorary Picks to Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar.

6402.name: Stormwind Rendezvous
objectivesText: Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.

6403.name: The Great Masquerade
objectivesText: Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!

6501.name: The Dragon's Eye
objectivesText: You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye. The only information you possess about such a being is that they exist.

6502.name: Drakefire Amulet
objectivesText: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath. Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire.

6603.name: Trouble in Winterspring!
objectivesText: Find Donova Snowden near the hot springs in Winterspring.

6604.name: Enraged Wildkin
objectivesText: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper at Starfall Village.

6606.name: A Little Luck
objectivesText: Speak with Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.

6607.name: Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme
objectivesText: Nat Pagle wants you to catch the following fish:
Misty Reed Mahi Mahi from the Misty Reed Strand in the Swamp of Sorrows.
A Sar'theris Striker from the Sar'theris Strand in Desolace.
Feralas Ahi from the Verdantis River of Feralas.
Savage Coast Blue Sailfin from the Savage Coast of Stranglethorn Vale.
Return to Nat Pagle when you have reeled them all in!

6609.name: I Got Nothin' Left!
objectivesText: Travel to Kalimdor, to the coastal city of Theramore. From there you must search for an island, south of the main town. Nat Pagle awaits your arrival!

6610.name: Clamlette Surprise
objectivesText: Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items:
12 Giant Eggs. You will find those on the Rocs wandering Tanaris or any other species of large bird.
10 pieces of Zesty Clam Meat. You can find those in clams, naturally!
20 pieces of Alterac Swiss. Get thee to a cheesery!
Gather all of the items and return to Dirge.

6612.name: I Know A Guy...
objectivesText: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.

6624.name: Triage
objectivesText: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.

6625.name: Alliance Trauma
objectivesText: Travel to Theramore in the Dustwallow Marsh and speak with Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen about joining the ranks of Alliance Trauma.

6626.name: A Host of Evil
objectivesText: Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.

6642.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Dark Iron Ore

6643.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Fiery Core

6644.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Lava Core

6645.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Core Leather

6646.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Blood of the Mountain

6661.name: Deeprun Rat Roundup
objectivesText: Capture 5 Deeprun Rats by using the Rat Catcher's Flute. Lead the rats back to Monty. Don't forget to turn in the flute when you're finished.

6662.name: Me Brother, Nipsy
objectivesText: Take the Carton of Mystery Meat to Nipsy at the Stormwind Deeprun Tram Depot.

6681.name: The Manor, Ravenholdt
objectivesText: Take the Seal of Ravenholdt to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad.
Your cunning will be tested along the way. Be prepared.

6721.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6722.name: The Hunter's Path
objectivesText: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6761.name: The New Frontier
objectivesText: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus.

6762.name: Rabine Saturna
objectivesText: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade. Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.

6804.name: Poisoned Water
objectivesText: Use the Aspect of Neptulon on poisoned elementals of Eastern Plaguelands. Bring 12 Discordant Bracers and the Aspect of Neptulon to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6805.name: Stormers and Rumblers
objectivesText: Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumblers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6821.name: Eye of the Emberseer
objectivesText: Bring the Eye of the Emberseer to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6822.name: The Molten Core
objectivesText: Kill 1 Fire Lord, 1 Molten Giant, 1 Ancient Core Hound and 1 Lava Surger, then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6823.name: Agent of Hydraxis
objectivesText: Earn an Honored faction with the Hydraxian Waterlords, then talk to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6824.name: Hands of the Enemy
objectivesText: Bring the Hands of Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6844.name: Umber, Archivist
objectivesText: Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

6845.name: Uncovering Past Secrets
objectivesText: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

6848.name: Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye
objectivesText: Recover Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye from the Winterax caves and return it to Master Ryson.
Be warned, it is said that Master Ryson's All Seeing Eye carries with it a terrible curse!

6981.name: The Glowing Shard
objectivesText: Travel to Ratchet to find someone that can tell you more about the glowing shard.
Then, deliver the shard as you are directed.

6982.name: Coldtooth Supplies
objectivesText: Bring 10 Coldtooth Supplies to the Alliance Quartermaster in Dun Baldar.

7003.name: Zapped Giants
objectivesText: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 15 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.

7022.name: Greatfather Winter is Here!
objectivesText: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Ironforge.

7023.name: Greatfather Winter is Here!
objectivesText: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Ironforge.

7025.name: Treats for Greatfather Winter
objectivesText: Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Greatfather Winter in Ironforge.

7027.name: Empty Stables
objectivesText: Locate an Alterac Ram in Alterac Valley. Use the Stormpike Training Collar when you are near the Alterac Ram to 'tame' the beast. Once tamed, the Alterac Ram will follow you back to the Stable Master. Speak with the Stable Master to earn credit for the capture.

7028.name: Twisted Evils
objectivesText: Collect 15 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.

7041.name: Vyletongue Corruption
objectivesText: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.
Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Talendria in Nijel's Point.

7042.name: Stolen Winter Veil Treats
objectivesText: Locate the Smokywood Pastures investigator that has gone missing in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

7043.name: You're a Mean One...
objectivesText: Locate and return the Stolen Treats to Wulmort Jinglepocket in Ironforge. It was last thought to be in the possession of the Abominable Greench, found somewhere in the snowy regions of the Alterac Mountains.

7044.name: Legends of Maraudon
objectivesText: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.
Find a way to speak with Celebras.

7045.name: A Smokywood Pastures' Thank You!
objectivesText: Speak with Greatfather Winter in Ironforge.

7046.name: The Scepter of Celebras
objectivesText: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras.
Speak with him when the ritual is complete.

7062.name: The Reason for the Season
objectivesText: Speak with Historian Karnik at the Explorer's League in Ironforge about the Feast of Winter Veil.

7063.name: The Feast of Winter Veil
objectivesText: Feel free to read the book, "The Feast of Winter Veil", to learn more about the holiday. When you are finished with the book, deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

7065.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
objectivesText: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Keeper Marandis at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

7066.name: Seed of Life
objectivesText: Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.

7067.name: The Pariah's Instructions
objectivesText: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.

7070.name: Shadowshard Fragments
objectivesText: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Archmage Tervosh in Theramore on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh.

7081.name: Alterac Valley Graveyards
objectivesText: Assault a graveyard, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

7102.name: Towers and Bunkers
objectivesText: Destroy the banner at an enemy tower or bunker, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

7121.name: The Quartermaster
objectivesText: Speak with the Stormpike Quartermaster.

7122.name: Capture a Mine
objectivesText: Capture a mine that the Stormpike does not control, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

7141.name: The Battle of Alterac
objectivesText: Enter Alterac Valley, defeat the Horde general Drek'thar, and then return to Prospector Stonehewer in the Alterac Mountains.

7162.name: Proving Grounds
objectivesText: Travel to the Icewing Caverns located southwest of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley and recover the Stormpike Banner. Return the Stormpike Banner to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.

7202.name: Korrak the Bloodrager
objectivesText: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
Should Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.

7221.name: Speak with Prospector Stonehewer
objectivesText: Speak with Prospector Stonehewer in the Dun Baldar garrison.

7223.name: Armor Scraps
objectivesText: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Murgot Deepforge in Dun Baldar.

7261.name: The Sovereign Imperative
objectivesText: Travel to Alterac Valley in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Outside of the entrance tunnel, find and speak with Lieutenant Haggerdin.
For the glory of Bronzebeard!

7282.name: Brotherly Love
objectivesText: Travel into Frostwolf territory and slay Commander Louis Philips. Return to Commander Karl Philips when the task is complete.

7301.name: Fallen Sky Lords
objectivesText: Travel to Frostwolf territory and search for Wing Commander Slidore, Wing Commander Vipore, and Wing Commander Ichman. Return to Commander Duffy should you complete your mission.

7364.name: Gnomeregan Bounty
objectivesText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing tauren players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a tauren and return to Dirk Swindle at Dun'Baldar with a Tauren Hoof.

7365.name: Staghelm's Requiem
objectivesText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing troll players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a troll and return to Athramanis at Dun'Baldar with Darkspear Troll Mojo.

7366.name: The Archbishop's Mercy
objectivesText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Forsaken players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a Forsaken and return to Commander Karl Philips (who wanders between the lumber mill and the mine) with a Forsaken Heart.

7367.name: Defusing the Threat
objectivesText: Find the Frostwolf Explosives Expert and kill him. Return to the Stormpike Explosives Expert when the task is complete.

7382.name: Korrak the Everliving
objectivesText: Should Korrak the Bloodrager make a return to the Field of Strife, seek him out and destroy him.
Return the Skull of Korrak to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

7383.name: Crown of the Earth
objectivesText: Fill the Amethyst Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.

7402.name: Wanted: ORCS!
objectivesText: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Orc players in Alterac Valley.
Kill an Orc and take their Orc Tooth back to Corporal Noreg Stormpike at Dun Baldar.

7441.name: Pusillin and the Elder Azj'Tordin
objectivesText: Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary.
Return to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations.

7461.name: The Madness Within
objectivesText: You must destroy the guardians surrounding the 5 Pylons that power the Prison of Immol'thar. Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated.
Enter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the foul demon that stands at its heart. Finally, confront Prince Tortheldrin in Athenaeum.
Return to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete this quest.

7462.name: The Treasure of the Shen'dralar
objectivesText: Return to the Athenaeum and find the Treasure of the Shen'dralar. Claim your reward!

7463.name: Arcane Refreshment
objectivesText: Travel to the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul and slay the water elemental, Hydrospawn. Return to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum with the Hydrospawn Essence.

7482.name: Elven Legends
objectivesText: Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Scholar Runethorn at Feathermoon with whatever information that you may find.

7483.name: Libram of Rapidity
objectivesText: Bring a Libram of Rapidity, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Blood of Heroes to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Rapidity.

7484.name: Libram of Focus
objectivesText: Bring a Libram of Focus, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 4 Large Brilliant Shards, and 2 Skin of Shadow to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Focus.

7485.name: Libram of Protection
objectivesText: Bring a Libram of Protection, 1 Pristine Black Diamond, 2 Large Brilliant Shards, and 1 Frayed Abomination Stitching to Lorekeeper Lydros in Dire Maul to receive an Arcanum of Protection.

7486.name: A Hero's Reward
objectivesText: Claim your reward from Hydraxis' Coffer.

7488.name: Lethtendris's Web
objectivesText: Bring Lethtendris' Web to Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

7494.name: Feathermoon Stronghold
objectivesText: Speak with Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

7495.name: Victory for the Alliance
objectivesText: Take the Head of Onyxia to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.

7496.name: Celebrating Good Times
objectivesText: Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes.

7498.name: Garona: A Study on Stealth and Treachery
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7499.name: Codex of Defense
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7500.name: The Arcanist's Cookbook
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7501.name: The Light and How To Swing It
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7502.name: Harnessing Shadows
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7503.name: The Greatest Race of Hunters
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7504.name: Holy Bologna: What the Light Won't Tell You
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7505.name: Frost Shock and You
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7506.name: The Emerald Dream...
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7507.name: Nostro's Compendium
objectivesText: Return Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying to the Athenaeum.

7508.name: The Forging of Quel'Serrar
objectivesText: Give the Dull and Flat Elven Blade to Lorekeeper Lydros.

7509.name: The Forging of Quel'Serrar
objectivesText: You must get Onyxia to breathe fire on the Unfired Ancient Blade. Once this is done, pick up the now Heated Ancient Blade. Be warned, a Heated Ancient Blade will not remain heated forever - time is of the essence.
The last step before returning to me is to slay the beast and drive the Heated Ancient Blade into her corpse.
Do this and Quel'Serrar will be yours.

7562.name: Mor'zul Bloodbringer
objectivesText: Speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

7563.name: Rage of Blood
objectivesText: Bring 30 bottles of Raging Beast's Blood to Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

7564.name: Wildeyes
objectivesText: Bring the Case of Blood to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7581.name: The Prison's Bindings
objectivesText: Travel to Dire Maul in Feralas and recover 15 Satyr Blood from the Wildspawn Satyr that inhabit the Warpwood Quarter. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when this is done.

7582.name: The Prison's Casing
objectivesText: Travel to Darkwhisper Gorge in Winterspring and recover 5 Tears of the Hederine from the Hederine demons that occupy the gorge. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when you have completed this task.

7583.name: Suppression
objectivesText: Venture forth into the Tainted Scar and locate a Doomguard Commander.
Use the Glowing Crystal Prison on the Doomguard Commander. Be prepared for a ferocious onslaught of attacks, as the demon attempts to escape capture.
Should you succeed, return the Imprisoned Doomguard to Daio in the Tainted Scar.

7601.name: What Niby Commands
objectivesText: Speak with Impsy in Felwood.

7602.name: Flawless Fel Essence
objectivesText: Impsy in Felwood has asked that you bring him three Flawless Fel Essences originating from three distinct locations.

The Legashi Satyrs of Azshara hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Jaedenar Legionnaires of Jaedenar hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Felguard Sentries of the Blasted Lands hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region.
Recover the Flawless Fel Essences and return to Impsy in Felwood.

7603.name: Kroshius' Infernal Core
objectivesText: Search Shatter Scar Vale in Felwood for the remains of Kroshius. When you locate the remains, use the Fel Fire near them and await Kroshius' return. When the infernal has awoken, slay him and take from his corpse Kroshius' Infernal Core.
Return Kroshius' Infernal Core to Niby the Almighty in Felwood.

7604.name: A Binding Contract
objectivesText: Turn the Thorium Brotherhood Contract in to Lokhtos Darkbargainer if you would like to receive the plans for Sulfuron.

7622.name: The Balance of Light and Shadow
objectivesText: Save 50 Peasants before 15 are slain. Speak with Eris Havenfire should you accomplish this task.
You may view the Death Post to view how many Peasants have been slain.

7623.name: Lord Banehollow
objectivesText: Purchase Shadowy Potions from Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.
Use the potions to travel through Jaedenar, and speak with Lord Banehollow.

7624.name: Ulathek the Traitor
objectivesText: Confront Ulathek, then bring The Traitor's Heart to Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar.

7625.name: Xorothian Stardust
objectivesText: Purchase Xorothian Stardust from Ur'dan. Bring it to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7626.name: Bell of Dethmoora
objectivesText: Bring 10 Elixirs of Shadow Power to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7627.name: Wheel of the Black March
objectivesText: Bring 6 Large Brilliant Shards and 25 Dark Iron Ore to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.

7628.name: Doomsday Candle
objectivesText: Bring 35 Black Dragonscales to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7629.name: Imp Delivery
objectivesText: Bring the Imp in a Jar to the alchemy lab in the Scholomance. After the parchment is created, return the jar to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.

7630.name: Arcanite
objectivesText: Bring 3 Arcanite Bar to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.

7631.name: Dreadsteed of Xoroth
objectivesText: Read Mor'zul's Instructions. Summon a Xorothian Dreadsteed, defeat it, then bind its spirit to you.

7632.name: The Ancient Leaf
objectivesText: Find the owner of the Ancient Petrified Leaf. Good luck, <Name>; It's a big world.

7634.name: Ancient Sinew Wrapped Lamina
objectivesText: Hastat the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Blue Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Hastat in Felwood.

7635.name: A Proper String
objectivesText: Stoma the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Black Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Stoma in Felwood.

7636.name: Stave of the Ancients
objectivesText: You must find and destroy these four demonic corrupters:
Simone the Seductress.
Klinfran the Crazed.
Solenor the Slayer.
Artorius the Doombringer.
Destroy these creatures and return to Vartrus the Ancient in Felwood with their heads.
Refer to the Petrified Bark in your inventory for clues as to their whereabouts.
You MUST complete this task by yourself.

7637.name: Emphasis on Sacrifice
objectivesText: Travel to Ironforge and get High Priest Rohan's Exorcism Censer. You will need to make a donation of 150 gold in order to secure it.

7638.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
objectivesText: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

7639.name: To Show Due Judgment
objectivesText: Return the Exorcism Censer to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7640.name: Exorcising Terrordale
objectivesText: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the spirits that torment Terrordale. When you have slain 25 Terrordale Spirits, return to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7641.name: The Work of Grimand Elmore
objectivesText: Speak with Grimand Elmore in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

7642.name: Collection of Goods
objectivesText: Bring 40 Runecloth, 6 Arcanite Bars, 10 Arthas' Tears, 5 Stratholme Holy Water vials, and 150 gold to Grimand Elmore in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

7643.name: Ancient Equine Spirit
objectivesText: Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse. Merideth Carlson in Southshore apparently is the source for such food.

Travel to the Dire Maul dungeon in Feralas and slay Tendris Warpwood. Doing so will free the Ancient Equine Spirit. Feed it the special horse feed, thereby soothing the spirit. Finally, give it the Arcanite Barding so it may bless it.

7644.name: Blessed Arcanite Barding
objectivesText: Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7645.name: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed
objectivesText: Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits - the key ingredient in making Manna-Enriched Horse Feed - for Merideth Carlson at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The Argent Dawn is known as the sole purveyor of the biscuits.
You also need to give her 50 gold to soothe her ruffled sensibilities.

7646.name: The Divination Scryer
objectivesText: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7647.name: Judgment and Redemption
objectivesText: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver. Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger.
Give the Charger's Redeemed Soul and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.

7648.name: Grimand's Finest Work
objectivesText: Take the Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District for his inspection.

7649.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume I
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7650.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume II
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7651.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume III
objectivesText: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7670.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
objectivesText: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

7677.name: White Stallion Exchange
objectivesText: If you bring me your white stallion, I'll trade you for one from the new herd. The new horse will be just as fast as your old one, but have a different look to it. You can look at the swift steeds here to see what it will look like.
MUST PAY 500 Gold too....

7701.name: WANTED: Overseer Maltorius
objectivesText: Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, in the Searing Gorge, you will find the traitorous Dark Iron dwarf named Overseer Maltorius.
Slay Overseer Maltorius and take his head. Return the head to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker in the Searing Gorge for your reward.

7703.name: Unfinished Gordok Business
objectivesText: Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul.
According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.

7704.name: Look at the Size of It!
objectivesText: Take Chambermaid Pillaclencher's Pillow to Evonice Sootsmoker in the Searing Gorge.

7721.name: Fuel for the Zapping
objectivesText: Collect 10 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

7722.name: What the Flux?
objectivesText: Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux that Overseer Maltorius stole. Find those plans and return them to Master Smith Burninate in the Searing Gorge.

7723.name: Curse These Fat Fingers
objectivesText: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Heavy War Golems.
The Heavy War Golems wander the areas surrounding the Cauldron in the Searing Gorge. When you've killed enough, return to Hansel in Searing Gorge.

7724.name: Fiery Menace!
objectivesText: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Greater Lava Spiders in the Searing Gorge. You can find Greater Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the Searing Gorge.
Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Greater Lava Spiders.

7725.name: Again With the Zapped Giants
objectivesText: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 10 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.

7726.name: Refuel for the Zapping
objectivesText: Collect 6 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

7727.name: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It
objectivesText: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Incendosaurs.
You will find Incendosaurs occupying the lava pools inside the Slag Pit. The Slag Pit can be found in the Cauldron of the Searing Gorge.
Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Incendosaurs.

7728.name: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
objectivesText: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge.

The only information you have about these items is the following: They were definitely stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. The Smithing Tuyere is a blacksmithing tool used by blacksmiths and the Lookout's Spyglass is an invaluable monitoring tool to lookouts.

7729.name: JOB OPPORTUNITY: Culling the Competition
objectivesText: Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge once you have accomplished this task.

7733.name: Improved Quality
objectivesText: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Pratt McGrubben at Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas.

7735.name: Pristine Yeti Hide
objectivesText: Bring the Pristine Yeti Hide to Pratt McGrubben at the Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas.

7736.name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Kingsblood

7761.name: Blackhand's Command
objectivesText: That is one stupid orc. It would appear as if you need to find this brand and gain the Mark of Drakkisath in order to access the Orb of Command.
The letter indicates that General Drakkisath guards the brand. Perhaps you should investigate.

7781.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objectivesText: Return the Head of Nefarian to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.

7782.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objectivesText: Venture to the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi.

7785.name: Examine the Vessel
objectivesText: Examine the Vessel of Rebirth and return it to Highlord Demitrian.

7786.name: Thunderaan the Windseeker
objectivesText: To free Thunderaan the Windseeker from his prison, you must present the right and left halves of the Bindings of the Windseeker, 10 bars of Elementium, and the Essence of the Firelord to Highlord Demitrian in Silithus.

7787.name: Rise, Thunderfury!
objectivesText: Present the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade to Highlord Demitrian.

7788.name: Vanquish the Invaders!
objectivesText: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.

7790.name: River Ends
objectivesText: Look for the cause of the Skyborne struggle along Thondroril River.

7810.name: Arena Master
objectivesText: Speak with Short John Mithril in the Stranglethorn Arena.

7848.name: Attunement to the Core
objectivesText: Venture to the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths and recover a Core Fragment. Return to Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain when you have recovered the Core Fragment.

7871.name: Vanquish the Invaders!
objectivesText: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.

7877.name: The Treasure of the Shen'dralar

7884.name: Crocolisk Boy and the Bearded Murloc

7886.name: Talismans of Merit
objectivesText: You obtained a Silverwing Talisman of Merit for your last task, talk to me again, and you gain your reward.

7887.name: Talismans of Merit

7905.name: The Darkmoon Faire
objectivesText: Deliver the Free Ticket Voucher to Gelvas Grimgate, located inside the Darkmoon Faire carnival.

7907.name: Darkmoon Beast Deck
objectivesText: Return the Beast Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.

7921.name: Talismans of Merit
objectivesText: You obtained a Silverwing Talisman of Merit for your last task, talk to me again, and you gain your reward.

7927.name: Darkmoon Portals Deck
objectivesText: Return the Portals Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.

7928.name: Darkmoon Warlords Deck

7929.name: Darkmoon Elementals Deck
objectivesText: Return the Elementals Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.

7937.name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
objectivesText: Travel to the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest and seek out your fortune.

7938.name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
objectivesText: Travel to the Deadmines in Westfall and seek out your fortune.

7944.name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
objectivesText: Travel to the Wailing Caverns in the Barrens and seek out your fortune.

7945.name: Your Fortune Awaits You...

objectivesText: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker Primal Hakkari Bindings. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.

8229.name: Could I get a Fishing Flier?

8232.name: The Green Drake

8233.name: A Simple Request

8234.name: Sealed Azure Bag
objectivesText: Retrieve the Sealed Azure Bag from the Timbermaw Shaman in Azshara. Then take the bag to Archmage Xylem, also found in Azshara.

8235.name: Encoded Fragments
objectivesText: Bring 10 Encoded Fragments to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.

8236.name: The Azure Key
objectivesText: Return the Azure Key to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt.

8240.name: A Bijou for Zanza
objectivesText: Destroy any one of the Hakkari Bijous found in Zul'Gurub at the Altar of Zanza on Yojamba Isle. When done, speak with Vinchaxa nearby.

8241.name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Iron

8242.name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Heavy Leather

8250.name: Magecraft
objectivesText: Seek out Sanath Lim-yo and gain passage to see Archmage Xylem.

8251.name: Magic Dust
objectivesText: Bring 10 Glittering Dust to Archmage Xylem.

8252.name: The Siren's Coral
objectivesText: Collect 6 Enchanted Coral and return them to Archmage Xylem.

8253.name: Destroy Morphaz
objectivesText: Retrieve the Arcane Shard from Morphaz and return to Archmage Xylem.

8254.name: Cenarion Aid
objectivesText: Seek out Ogtinc in Azshara.

8255.name: Of Coursers We Know
objectivesText: Acquire 4 Healthy Courser Glands and bring them to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.

8256.name: The Ichor of Undeath
objectivesText: Acquire an Ichor of Undeath for Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.

8257.name: Blood of Morphaz
objectivesText: Kill Morphaz in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar, and return his blood to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood. The entrance to the sunken temple can be found in the Swamp of Sorrows.

8268.name: Ribbons of Sacrifice
objectivesText: Bring the Ribbons of Sacrifice to Sentinel Farsong so that the Sentinels may reward you for acting on our behalf.

8269.name: Ribbons of Sacrifice
objectivesText: Bring the Ribbons of Sacrifice to Sentinel Farsong so that the Sentinels may reward you for acting on our behalf.

8275.name: Taking Back Silithus
objectivesText: Talk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

8277.name: Deadly Desert Venom
objectivesText: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 8 Stonelash Scorpid Stingers and 8 Sand Skitterer Fangs. Return to her when you have completed the task.

8278.name: Noggle's Last Hope
objectivesText: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 3 Stonelash Pincer Stingers, 3 Stonelash Flayer Stingers and 3 Rock Stalker Fangs.

8279.name: The Twilight Lexicon
objectivesText: Bring the three chapters of the Twilight Lexicon to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.

8280.name: Securing the Supply Lines
objectivesText: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to kill 15 Dredge Strikers.

8281.name: Stepping Up Security
objectivesText: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to slay 20 Dredge Crushers.

8282.name: Noggle's Lost Satchel
objectivesText: Retrieve Noggle's Satchel from the mountains in the south of Silithus and return it to him at Cenarion Hold.

8283.name: Wanted - Deathclasp, Terror of the Sands
objectivesText: Bring Deathclasp's Pincer to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard.

8284.name: The Twilight Mystery
objectivesText: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to collect 8 Twilight Tablet Fragments.

8285.name: The Deserter
objectivesText: Take the restored tablet to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.

8286.name: What Tomorrow Brings
objectivesText: Venture to the Caverns of Time in Tanaris and find Anachronos, Brood of Nozdormu.

8287.name: A Terrible Purpose
objectivesText: Take the Decoded Tablet Parchment to Commander Mar'alith.

8288.name: Only One May Rise
objectivesText: Return the Head of the Broodlord Lashlayer to Baristolth of the Shifting Sands at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

8290.name: Vanquish the Invaders
objectivesText: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.

8291.name: Vanquish the Invaders!
objectivesText: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Horde, obtain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and return to Sentinel Farsong at the Silverwing Grove.

8292.name: Talismans of Merit
objectivesText: You obtained a Silverwing Talisman of Merit for your last task, talk to me again, and you gain your reward.

8297.name: Arathi Basin Resources!
objectivesText: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Sergeant Maclear at Refuge Pointe.

8298.name: More Resource Crates
objectivesText: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Sergeant Maclear at Refuge Pointe.

8301.name: The Path of the Righteous
objectivesText: Collect 200 Silithid Carapace Fragments and return to Baristolth.

8302.name: The Hand of the Righteous
objectivesText: Collect 200 Silithid Carapace Fragments and return to Baristolth.

8303.name: Anachronos
objectivesText: Seek out Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

8304.name: Dearest Natalia
objectivesText: Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to question the inhabitants of Bronzebeard's Encampment. You will find Bronzebeard's Encampment south of Cenarion Hold.
Once you have gathered the requested information, return to Commander Mar'alith.

8305.name: Long Forgotten Memories
objectivesText: Locate the Crystalline Tear in Silithus and gaze into its depths.

8306.name: Into The Maw of Madness

creatures.text: The Fate of Mistress Natalia Mar'alith

objectivesText: Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to find his beloved Natalia. The information that you gathered points to Hive'Regal in the south as being the area in which you may find Mistress Natalia Mar'alith.
Do not forget to visit the dwarves at Bronzebeard's camp before venturing into the hive. They might have some additional work and advice for you.
And <Name>, remember the Commander's words: "Do what you must..."

8307.name: Desert Recipe
objectivesText: Look for information about cooking Sandworm Meat at the Twilight's Hammer camp west of Cenarion Hold.

8308.name: Brann Bronzebeard's Lost Letter
objectivesText: Take Brann Bronzebeard's Letter to Bronzebeard's Encampment in southern Silithus.

8309.name: Glyph Chasing
objectivesText: Rutgar Glyphshaper at Bronzebeard's Encampment in Silithus wants you to venture to Hive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, and Hive'Regal and recover Glyphed Rubbings from the Glyphed Crystals of each hive.
Use the Geologist's Transcription Kit to make a reasonable facsimile of the ancient glyphs. Return to Rutgar Glyphshaper when you complete this task.

8310.name: Breaking the Code
objectivesText: Frankal Stonebridge at Bronzebeard's Encampment in Silithus wants you to recover a Hive'Zora Silithid Brain, Hive'Ashi Silithid Brain, and a Hive'Regal Silithid Brain. Return to Frankal when you have completed this task.

8311.name: Hallow's End Treats for Jesper!
objectivesText: Speak with the innkeepers of Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus, as well as Talvash del Kissel in Ironforge. Perform the tricks they ask of you in exchange for the treats they offer.
Return to Jesper at the Stormwind Orphanage with a Darnassus Marzipan, Gnomeregan Gumdrop, Stormwind Nougat, and Ironforge Mint.

8313.name: Sharing the Knowledge
objectivesText: Bring the Torn Recipe Page to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold.

8314.name: Unraveling the Mystery
objectivesText: Rutgar Glyphshaper at Bronzebeard's Encampment wants you to deliver the Glyphed Crystal Prism to Geologist Larksbane at the Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

8315.name: The Calling
objectivesText: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to recover the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism from the Qiraji Emissary.

You have been instructed to take the Glyphs of Calling to the Bones of Grakkarond, south of Cenarion Hold, and draw them in the sand. Should the Qiraji Emissary appear, slay it and recover the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism. Return to Geologist Larksbane if you succeed.
Assemble an army for this task, <Name>!

8317.name: Kitchen Assistance
objectivesText: Calandrath at Cenarion Hold needs a batch of 10 Smoked Desert Dumplings.

8318.name: Secret Communication
objectivesText: Bring 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

8320.name: Twilight Geolords
objectivesText: Kill 10 Twilight Geolords, then return to Huum Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

8321.name: Vyral the Vile
objectivesText: Bring Vyral's Signet Ring to Huum Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

8323.name: True Believers
objectivesText: Hermit Ortell wants you to bring him 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts

8331.name: Aurel Goldleaf
objectivesText: Speak with Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.

8332.name: Dukes of the Council
objectivesText: Bring 1 Large Brilliant Shard and 3 Abyssal Crests to Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.

8341.name: Lords of the Council
objectivesText: Bring 5 Large Brilliant Shards and 3 Abyssal Signets to Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.

8343.name: Goldleaf's Discovery
objectivesText: Speak with Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.

8348.name: Signet of the Dukes
objectivesText: Bring the Abyssal Signet to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

8349.name: Bor Wildmane

8351.name: Bor Wishes to Speak
objectivesText: Speak with Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

8352.name: Scepter of the Council
objectivesText: Bring an Abyssal Scepter to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.

8353.name: Chicken Clucking for a Mint
objectivesText: Do a chicken emote at Innkeeper Firebrew, and in exchange you'll receive an Ironforge Mint!

8355.name: Incoming Gumdrop
objectivesText: Do a train emote at Talvash del Kissel, and in exchange you'll receive a Gnomeregan Gumdrop!

8356.name: Flexing for Nougat
objectivesText: Do a flex emote at Innkeeper Allison, and in exchange you'll receive Stormwind Nougat!

8357.name: Dancing for Marzipan
objectivesText: Do a dance emote at Innkeeper Saelienne, and in exchange you'll receive Darnassus Marzipan!

8361.name: Abyssal Contacts
objectivesText: Bor Wildmane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to destroy an Abyssal Templar and bring him an Abyssal Crest as proof of the deed.

8365.name: Pirate Hats Ahoy!
objectivesText: Haughty Modiste wants you to collect 20 Southsea Pirate Hats and return them to her at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

8366.name: Southsea Shakedown
objectivesText: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris wants you to kill 10 Southsea Pirates, 10 Southsea Freebooters, 10 Southsea Dock Workers and 10 Southsea Swashbucklers.

8371.name: Concerted Efforts
objectivesText: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Mark of Honor, 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor and 3 Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

8372.name: Fight for Warsong Gulch
objectivesText: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.

8373.name: The Power of Pine
objectivesText: Use a Stink Bomb Cleaner to remove any Forsaken Stink Bomb that's been dropped on Southshore. Return to Sergeant Hartman in Southshore when you're done.

8374.name: Claiming Arathi Basin

8375.name: Remember Alterac Valley!

8414.name: Dispelling Evil
objectivesText: Collect 20 Minion's Scourgestones and bring them to High Priest Thel'danis in the Western Plaguelands.

8415.name: Chillwind Point
objectivesText: Speak to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp.

8416.name: Inert Scourgestones
objectivesText: Bring the Inert Scourgestone to Commander Ashlan Valorfist in Chillwind Point.

8417.name: A Troubled Spirit
objectivesText: Speak with the Fallen Hero of the Horde at the entrance to the Blasted Lands.

8418.name: Forging the Mightstone

8423.name: Warrior Kinship
objectivesText: Kill 7 Helboar in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

8424.name: War on the Shadowsworn
objectivesText: Slaughter the Shadowsworn in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

8425.name: Voodoo Feathers
objectivesText: Bring the Voodoo Feathers from the trolls in the Sunken Temple to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

8446.name: Shrouded in Nightmare
objectivesText: Find someone capable of deciphering the meaning behind the Nightmare Engulfed Object.
Perhaps a druid of great power could assist you.

8447.name: Waking Legends
objectivesText: Wait for Keeper Remulos at the Moonglade to cleanse the Nightmare Engulfed Object.

8460.name: Timbermaw Ally
objectivesText: Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 6 Deadwood Warriors, 6 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 6 Deadwood Gardeners. Return to him in southern Felwood near the Emerald Sanctuary when you are done.

8461.name: Deadwood of the North
objectivesText: Nafien would like you to kill 6 Deadwood Den Watchers, 6 Deadwood Avengers, and 6 Deadwood Shamans. Return to him in northern Felwood near the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.

8462.name: Speak to Nafien
objectivesText: Travel north along the main road in Felwood and speak with the furbolg named Nafien. He stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.

8464.name: Winterfall Activity
objectivesText: Salfa wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Shaman, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Ursa. Salfa is located just outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold in Winterspring.

8465.name: Speak to Salfa
objectivesText: Travel through Timbermaw Hold and exit into Winterspring. Speak with Salfa, who stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.

8470.name: Deadwood Ritual Totem
objectivesText: Take the Deadwood Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.

8471.name: Winterfall Ritual Totem
objectivesText: Take the Winterfall Ritual Totem inside Timbermaw Hold and see if one of the furbolgs there will find a use for the item. The Timbermaw will not speak with you unless you are of Neutral reputation or greater with them.

8481.name: The Root of All Evil
objectivesText: Plant the Demon Summoning Torch in the mouth of High Chief Winterfall's cave in the Winterfall furbolg village. Defeat the demon and retrieve the Essence of Xandivious for Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold.

8484.name: The Brokering of Peace
objectivesText: Bring the Timbermaw Offering of Peace to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

8492.name: The Alliance Needs Copper Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Copper Bars to Sergeant Stonebrow at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8493.name: The Alliance Needs More Copper Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 copper bars to Sergeant Stonebrow at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8494.name: The Alliance Needs Iron Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Iron Bars to Corporal Carnes at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8495.name: The Alliance Needs More Iron Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 iron bars to Corporal Carnes at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8496.name: Bandages for the Field
objectivesText: Bring 30 Heavy Runecloth Bandages, 30 Heavy Silk Bandages and 30 Heavy Mageweave Bandages to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.

8497.name: Desert Survival Kits
objectivesText: Bring 4 Globes of Water, 4 Powerful Anti-Venom and 4 Smoked Desert Dumplings to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing I in order to complete this quest.

8498.name: Twilight Battle Orders
objectivesText: Obtain the Twilight Battle Orders and bring them Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.

8499.name: The Alliance Needs Thorium Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Thorium Bars to Dame Twinbraid at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8500.name: The Alliance Needs More Thorium Bars!
objectivesText: Bring 20 thorium bars to Dame Twinbraid at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8501.name: Target: Hive'Ashi Stingers
objectivesText: Kill 30 Hive'Ashi Stingers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing XII in order to complete this quest.

8502.name: Target: Hive'Ashi Workers
objectivesText: Slay 30 Hive'Ashi Workers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.

8503.name: The Alliance Needs Stranglekelp!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Stranglekelp to Private Draxlegauge at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8504.name: The Alliance Needs More Stranglekelp!
objectivesText: Bring 20 stranglekelp to Private Draxlegauge at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8505.name: The Alliance Needs Purple Lotus!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Purple Lotus to Master Nightsong at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8506.name: The Alliance Needs More Purple Lotus!
objectivesText: Bring 20 purple lotus to Master Nightsong at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8507.name: Field Duty
objectivesText: Report for duty at the Ironforge Brigade post near Hive'Zora. Prepare your Unsigned Field Duty Papers and obtain Signed Field Duty Papers from Captain Blackanvil and return to Windcaller Kaldon at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Note: Healing or casting beneficial spells on a member of the Ironforge Brigade will flag you for PvP.

8509.name: The Alliance Needs Arthas' Tears!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Arthas' Tears to Sergeant Major Germaine at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8510.name: The Alliance Needs More Arthas' Tears!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Arthas' Tears to Sergeant Major Germaine at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8511.name: The Alliance Needs Light Leather!
objectivesText: Bring 10 Light Leather to Bonnie Stoneflayer at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8512.name: The Alliance Needs Light Leather!
objectivesText: Bring 10 light leather to Bonnie Stoneflayer at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8513.name: The Alliance Needs Medium Leather!
objectivesText: Bring 10 Medium Leather to Private Porter at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8514.name: The Alliance Needs More Medium Leather!
objectivesText: Bring 10 medium leather to Private Porter at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8515.name: The Alliance Needs Thick Leather!
objectivesText: Bring 10 Thick Leather to Marta Finespindle at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8516.name: The Alliance Needs More Thick Leather!
objectivesText: Bring 10 thick leather to Marta Finespindle at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8517.name: The Alliance Needs Linen Bandages!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Linen Bandages to Sentinel Silversky at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8518.name: The Alliance Needs More Linen Bandages!
objectivesText: Bring 20 linen bandages to Sentinel Silversky at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8519.name: A Pawn on the Eternal Board
objectivesText: Learn all that you can of the past, then speak with Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

8520.name: The Alliance Needs Silk Bandages!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Silk Bandages to Nurse Stonefield at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8521.name: The Alliance Needs More Silk Bandages!
objectivesText: Bring 20 silk bandages to Nurse Stonefield at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8522.name: The Alliance Needs Runecloth Bandages!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Runecloth Bandages to Keeper Moonshade at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8523.name: The Alliance Needs More Runecloth Bandages!
objectivesText: Bring 20 runecloth bandages to Keeper Moonshade at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8524.name: The Alliance Needs Rainbow Fin Albacore!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Rainbow Fin Albacore to Slicky Gastronome at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8525.name: The Alliance Needs More Rainbow Fin Albacore!
objectivesText: Bring 20 rainbow fin albacore to Slicky Gastronome at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8526.name: The Alliance Needs Roast Raptor!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Roast Raptor to Sarah Sadwhistle at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8527.name: The Alliance Needs More Roast Raptor!
objectivesText: Bring 20 roast raptor to Sarah Sadwhistle at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8528.name: The Alliance Needs Spotted Yellowtail!
objectivesText: Bring 20 Spotted Yellowtail to Huntress Swiftriver at the Military Ward in Ironforge.

8529.name: The Alliance Needs More Spotted Yellowtail!
objectivesText: Bring 20 spotted yellowtail to Huntress Swiftriver at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8534.name: Hive'Zora Scout Report
objectivesText: Contact Cenarion Scout Azenel inside Hive'Zora and return the Hive'Zora Scout Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.

8535.name: Hoary Templar
objectivesText: Summon and slay a Hoary Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.

8536.name: Earthen Templar
objectivesText: Summon and slay an Earthen Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.

8537.name: Crimson Templar
objectivesText: Summon and slay a Crimson Templar and report back to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing II in order to complete this quest.

8538.name: The Four Dukes
objectivesText: Find a way to summon and slay the Duke of Cynders, the Duke of Fathoms, the Duke of Zephyrs and the Duke of Shards and report back to Commander Mar'alith in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing V in order to complete this quest.

8539.name: Target: Hive'Zora Hive Sisters
objectivesText: Slay 30 Hive'Zora Hive Sisters and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing V in order to complete this quest.

8540.name: Boots for the Guard
objectivesText: Bring 3 Ornate Mithril Boots to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing II in order to complete this quest.

8541.name: Grinding Stones for the Guard
objectivesText: Bring 10 Dense Grinding Stones, 10 Solid Grinding Stones and 10 Heavy Grinding Stones to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.

8544.name: Conqueror's Spaulders
objectivesText: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Command, 2 Idols of Night, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

8548.name: Volunteer's Battlegear
objectivesText: Bring 5 Cenarion Combat Badges, 3 Cenarion Logistics Badges and 7 Cenarion Tactical Badges to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also attain Friendly reputation with Cenarion Circle to be able to complete this quest.

8551.name: The Captain's Chest
objectivesText: Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.

8552.name: The Monogrammed Sash
objectivesText: Return the Monogrammed Sash to its owner.

8553.name: The Captain's Cutlass
objectivesText: Speak with Sprogger.

8554.name: Facing Negolash
objectivesText: Bring 10 Barbecued Buzzard Wings and 5 bottles of Junglevine Wine to Captain Smotts' Lifeboat.
Kill Negolash, and bring Smotts' Cutlass to Captain Smotts in Stranglethorn.

8556.name: Signet of Unyielding Strength
objectivesText: Bring 1 Qiraji Magisterial Ring, 2 Lambent Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.

8557.name: Drape of Unyielding Strength
objectivesText: Bring 1 Qiraji Martial Drape, 2 Onyx Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.

8558.name: Sickle of Unyielding Strength
objectivesText: Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Alabaster Idols, 5 Crystal Scarabs and 5 Stone Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.

8559.name: Conqueror's Greaves

8867.name: Lunar Fireworks
objectivesText: Launch 8 Lunar Fireworks and 2 Cluster Fireworks and return to a Lunar Festival Harbinger at any capital city.

8868.name: Elune's Blessing
objectivesText: Summon Omen, defeat him and gain Elune's Blessing. Return to Valadar Starsong in Nighthaven

8869.name: Sweet Serenity
objectivesText: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.

8870.name: The Lunar Festival

8871.name: The Lunar Festival

8872.name: The Lunar Festival
objectivesText: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.

8883.name: Valadar Starsong
objectivesText: Use your Lunar Festival Invitation in the moonlight to travel to Moonglade. Speak with Valadar Starsong in Nighthaven when you arrive.

8899.name: Dearest Colara,

8903.name: Dangerous Love

8922.name: A Supernatural Device

8924.name: Hunting for Ectoplasm
objectivesText: Use the Ectoplasmic Distiller near incorporeal undead to collect 12 Scorched Ectoplasms in Silithus, 12 Frozen Ectoplasms in Winterspring and 12 Stable Ectoplasms in the Eastern Plaguelands. Bring them along with the Ectoplasmic Distiller back to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.

8925.name: A Portable Power Source
objectivesText: Find Magma Lord Bokk in the Burning Steppes, obtain his Magma Core and bring it to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.

8926.name: Just Compensation
objectivesText: Bring a Wildheart Belt and a set of Wildheart Gloves Deliana in Ironforge.

8928.name: A Shifty Merchant
objectivesText: Search for an imp inside a cave at the entrance of Darkwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, purchase a Fel Elemental Rod and return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.

8929.name: In Search of Anthion
objectivesText: Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to Stratholme and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.

8931.name: Just Compensation
objectivesText: Bring a Beaststalker's Belt and a set of Beaststalker's Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.

8932.name: Just Compensation
objectivesText: Bring a Magister's Belt and a set of Magister's Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.

8933.name: Just Compensation
objectivesText: Bring a Lightforge Belt and a set of Lightforge Gauntlets to Deliana in Ironforge.

8945.name: Dead Man's Plea

8946.name: Proof of Life
objectivesText: Bring Ysida's Locket to Anthion Harmon in Eastern Plaguelands.

8947.name: Anthion's Strange Request
objectivesText: Bring 3 Dark Iron Bars, 20 Enchanted Leather, 3 Mooncloth and 4 Cured Rugged Hides to Anthion Harmon in the Eastern Plaguelands.

8948.name: Anthion's Old Friend
objectivesText: Take the incomplete Banner of Provocation to Falrin Treeshaper at the library in Dire Maul.

8949.name: Falrin's Vendetta
objectivesText: Collect 25 Ogre Warbeads from Ogres inside Dire Maul or Blackrock Spire and return to Falrin Treeshaper inside the Athenaeum in Dire Maul.

8950.name: The Instigator's Enchantment
objectivesText: Bring the following to Falrin Treeshaper inside Dire Maul: 1 Jeering Spectre's Essence, 4 Dark Runes and 8 Large Brilliant Shards.

8951.name: Anthion's Parting Words
objectivesText: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Wildheart Boots, a Wildheart Kilt and Wildheart Spaulders.

8952.name: Anthion's Parting Words

8959.name: Anthion's Parting Words

8960.name: Bodley's Unfortunate Fate

8961.name: Three Kings of Flame
objectivesText: Gather the Incendicite of Incendius, the Ember of Emberseer and the Cinder of Cynders, along with a Hallowed Brazier, and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.

8962.name: Components of Importance
objectivesText: Acquire Druidical Remains and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.

8963.name: Components of Importance
objectivesText: Acquire a Starbreeze Village Relic and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.

8964.name: Components of Importance
objectivesText: Retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.

8965.name: Components of Importance
objectivesText: Obtain Soul Ashes of the Banished and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.

8966.name: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Mor Grayhoof and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.

8967.name: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.

8968.name: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

8969.name: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

8970.name: I See Alcaz Island In Your Future...

8977.name: Return to Deliana

8985.name: More Components of Importance
objectivesText: Acquire a Starbreeze Village Relic and return it to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.

8989.name: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

8990.name: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
objectivesText: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.

8995.name: Mea Culpa, Lord Valthalak

8996.name: Return to Bodley

8997.name: Back to the Beginning

8999.name: Saving the Best for Last

9015.name: The Challenge
objectivesText: Travel to the Ring of the Law in Blackrock Depths and place the Banner of Provocation in its center as you are sentenced by High Justice Grimstone. Slay Theldren and his gladiators and return to Anthion Harmon in the Eastern Plaguelands with the first piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet.

9024.name: Aristan's Hunch

9026.name: Tracing the Source

9027.name: Tracing the Source
