objectivesText: Bring Warlord Krellian's head to Commander Truesong in Azshara.

88821.name: Making Contact
objectivesText: Find the Kaldorei woman last seen on the Shattered Strand.

88857.name: Saving a Sentinel
objectivesText: Help Keldara Sunblade escape the Haldarr Encampment, then speak to Commander Truesong at Talrendis Point.

88884.name: Highborne Tablets
objectivesText: Find the three highborne tablets among the ruins of Southridge Beach, then bring them to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.

88917.name: Slithering Looters
objectivesText: Find the Staff of Archmage Selwyn among the Ruins of Eldarath, and bring it to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.

89001.name: Home on the Range
objectivesText: Bring 5 Mosshoof Hides to Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara.

89013.name: Gettin' Buzzed
objectivesText: Gather 5 Wild Honey from Wasp Nests using Berdun's Pellet Gun.

89015.name: Deadliest Catch
objectivesText: Bring a Mammoth Shark Steak to Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara.

89037.name: Murloc Thieves
objectivesText: Take the Memory Crystal from Razorgill near the Tower of Eldara, and bring it to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.

89038.name: A Monumental Task
objectivesText: Search for the Mark of the Queen among the ruins of the Ravencrest Monument, and bring it to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.

89053.name: Your Final Reward
objectivesText: See what Saria has to show you.

89228.name: Winter Frontier Fishery
objectivesText: Fish up 10 Winter Squid for Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point, in Azshara.

89470.name: Ill Tidings
objectivesText: Bring Saria's Knapsack back to Commander Truesong at Talrendis Point.

90487.name: Ancient Allies
objectivesText: Travel west from the hermit's cave to find an outpost of ancients and dryads on the lower slopes of Mount Hyjal.

90647.name: The Staff of the Mountain
objectivesText: Bring the Staff of the Mountain to Tiala Whitemane at the Summit of Eternity.

90702.name: Disturbed Grave
objectivesText: Search the area for the grave's missing contents.

90750.name: More Work?
objectivesText: Speak with the peasant to let him know the job's done.

90789.name: Scalebeard
objectivesText: Retrieve the Prismatic Shell for Archmage Xylem.  The Archmage resides in a tower atop the cliffs of Azshara.

90813.name: Pay Dirt!
objectivesText: Find someone to appraise the Humongous Crystal.

90865.name: Eyes of the Watchers
objectivesText: Retrieve 8 Watcher's Eyes for Eluneth.

91564.name: Itching for a Fixing
objectivesText: Bring 2 Mithril Casings and 1 Mechanical Repair Kit to Hnaz Blunderflame.

91688.name: To the Summit of Eternity
objectivesText: Travel to the Summit of Eternity and speak with the druids about the survivor village.

91696.name: Open Season
objectivesText: Escort the Barkskin Matriarch out of Deadwood Den and return to Barkskin Burrow.

91697.name: Meet the Elders
objectivesText: Find and speak with Elder Mistpaw and Elder Pinespeaker within Barkskin Burrow.

91698.name: Barkskin Breakout
objectivesText: Recover a Deadwood Key from a Deadwood Warden and return to the Barkskin Cage.

91723.name: Delicate Instruments
objectivesText: Kill 8 Kobold Geomancers in Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.

91724.name: Delicate Instruments
objectivesText: Kill 8 Defias Rogue Wizards at Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.

91725.name: Stolen Enchanting Supplies
objectivesText: Collect 5 Stolen Enchanting Supplies from gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Blixie Fitzwink near the Tower of Azora.

91732.name: Good Steel
objectivesText: Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.

91733.name: Downstream
objectivesText: Collect the Waterlogged Axe, Waterlogged Saw, and Waterlogged Toolbox that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford.

91740.name: Croaky's Head
objectivesText: Deliver Croaky's Head to Merell Ross at Ridgepoint Tower.

91741.name: Nibbled-On Book
objectivesText: Return the book to Brother Paxton.

91743.name: Rascally Rodents
objectivesText: Retrieve 8 Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.

91745.name: Mining Consultant
objectivesText: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.

91746.name: Elmpaw's Head
objectivesText: Deliver Elmpaw's Head to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.

91751.name: Rough Wolf Pelts
objectivesText: Skin wolves around Elwynn Forest to obtain 7 Rough Wolf Pelts, then deliver them to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.

91752.name: The Big Picture
objectivesText: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.

91753.name: An Enchanting Lesson
objectivesText: Kitta Firewind in the Tower of Azora wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue.
Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Crude Wax Effigies dropped by Kobold Geomancers.

91754.name: Rub Some Dirt In It
objectivesText: Collect 6 samples of Untainted Soil from around the foothills of Mount Hyjal.

91755.name: Leaves to Ligatures
objectivesText: Collect 12 Verdant Leaves from Tainted Shrubbery in the foothills of Mount Hyjal.

91758.name: Follow That Kobold!
objectivesText: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.

91770.name: Bark Bite
objectivesText: Apply the poultice to Fraxinus.

91772.name: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds
objectivesText: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.

91775.name: Book Return
objectivesText: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.

91777.name: Rare Books
objectivesText: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.

91877.name: Demon Hunter's Hunter
objectivesText: Find Maerion Thaelemaches somewhere on Mount Hyjal.

91881.name: The Western Post
objectivesText: Meet Sefira Everbright at the outpost.

91882.name: The Grand Alliance
objectivesText: Search Mount Hyjal for remnants of the Grand Alliance.

91883.name: Spear of the Skylord
objectivesText: Slay Zarrat Wormwing and return Omnuron's Spear.

91923.name: Celastrus the Bitter
objectivesText: Find and destroy Celastrus the Bitter, and return to Thylaen with its broken frond.

91952.name: The Source of the Corruption
objectivesText: Find the hermit Ketharas on Mount Hyjal.

92008.name: Premiere Parts
objectivesText: Retrieve Kaylaena Springbolt's parts order from Nami in Everlook.

92009.name: Crate Expectations
objectivesText: Gently transport the crate of parts and baubles to Kaylaena Springwhisper in Mount Hyjal.

92011.name: Rubble Rummage
objectivesText: Scavenge the remains of the Horde base and return 5 Frayed Wire, 5 Scrap Metal, and 5 Calcified Excrement to Kaylaena.

92014.name: Fox Hole
objectivesText: Return 9 Rustleaf Fox Tails to Johun "Punchy" Dillas in Hyjal.

92015.name: Area Denial Skunks
objectivesText: Make skunks leave the area around Johun's equipment without killing them.

92016.name: Rootwork
objectivesText: Enter the Well of Eternity and examine the roots of Nordrassil.

92017.name: Cleansing Winds
objectivesText: Collect 5 Grand Hippogryph Feathers and 3 Oily Chimaera Hair for Marn.

92020.name: Hol'anyee's Big Book of Big Lizards
objectivesText: Take Hol'anyee's Big Book of Big Lizards to a druid at the summit of Mount Hyjal.

92064.name: Tree Free
objectivesText: Break the tree branch to free Fenwick Togglespring.

92065.name: Blackmaw Reclamation
objectivesText: Bring Varrox Bleakhoof's Head to Gatekeeper Rageroar at Ursolan.

92066.name: The Twin Bears
objectivesText: Find the Totem of Ursoc and the Totem of Ursol inside Blackmaw Hold. Then, return them to Lorekeeper Nok at Ursolan.

92069.name: Claws That Rend, Tusks that Gore
objectivesText: Bring the Claws of the Great Bear and the Tusks of the Unbroken to Ogtinc, in Azshara.

92070.name: A Lost Memento
objectivesText: Find the owner of the Feathered Charm Necklace.

92094.name: Rocket Gnomes
objectivesText: Wennzut Togglespring lost sight of his brother, Fenwick, floating in his parachute into Hyjal. Look for where he may have ended up.

92100.name: Anywhere But Here
objectivesText: Find the Veteran of the Third War's scabbard near Elderwild.

92101.name: Lifted by Legacy
objectivesText: Find the Veteran of the Third War's markings of significance on the Great Lift.

92102.name: Praise
objectivesText: Use the Embroidered Scabbard to meet the Veteran of the Third War in Mount Hyjal near the broken cannon in Mourning's Rest.

92109.name: My First Alchemy Set
objectivesText: Bring 5 Empty Vials, 5 Silverleaf, and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.

92110.name: My First Real Potion
objectivesText: Gather 3 Murloc Eyes for the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.

92111.name: Of Friend and Fur
objectivesText: Enter Barkskin Burrow and find the furbolg they call Osi.

92124.name: Book Inventory
objectivesText: Speak to Daniel, Brother Paxton's assistant in the library.

92147.name: Highfeather Helper
objectivesText: Slay 18 Wormwing harpies on Mount Hyjal and bring their feathers to Phoebe Highfeather.

92169.name: Paying Back the Pact
objectivesText: Use the Staff of the Mountain on 10  members of the Blackthorne Pact on the Summit of Eternity to remove their wards and then kill them.

92171.name: Taking to New Heights
objectivesText: Travel to the Shrine of Aviana on Mount Hyjal and seek out Skylord Omnuron for aid.

92189.name: Back to the Grind
objectivesText: Bring 2 Dense Sharpening Stones and 2 Dense Grinding Stones to Trigg Ironhand in Elderwild on Mount Hyjal.

92317.name: Stolen Life
objectivesText: Acquire a Drop of Stolen Life from the Scourge in the ruins on Mount Hyjal, then return to Ketharas.

92328.name: Siegecraft
objectivesText: Turn the two gears and connect the two battery terminals on both sides of Kaylaena's Glaive Thrower.

92329.name: Drum Up Trouble
objectivesText: Walk to the ridge south of Kaylaena's workshop and find a way to make a loud distracting commotion to draw the chimaera Ghansurok in range to be attacked.

92335.name: Ashes of the Legion Ascent
objectivesText: Fetch a pinch of Azgalor's Ashes from the ruins of Dae'gun on Mount Hyjal.

92344.name: Get to the Roots of It
objectivesText: Gather 10 Nordrassil Root Caps inside Blackmaw Hold for Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus.

92345.name: Beneath Nordrassil
objectivesText: Speak to Mathrengyl Bearwalker at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.

92415.name: Remember That I Love You
objectivesText: Bring the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind City.

92432.name: An Alarming Request
objectivesText: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.

92433.name: Now We're Cooking
objectivesText: Bring 6 Savory Stag Sliders to Hnaz Blunderflame in Elderwild.

92449.name: Blight No More
objectivesText: Eliminate 3 Forgotten Soldiers and 12 Fleshflay Raveners.

92456.name: A Green Sample
objectivesText: Collect a Fel Infused Blossom from the City of Dalaran for Shylamiir in Stormwind City.

92457.name: Starving Arcane
objectivesText: Defeat 8 Seeking Remnants, 8 Saturated Remnants, and 8 Mana Echoes inside the City of Dalaran for Archmage Modera outside of Dalaran.

92458.name: Heart of Disruption
objectivesText: Collect the Arcane Mote for the Image of Archmage Modera near the City of Dalaran.

92459.name: Friend of the Kirin Tor
objectivesText: Speak to Archmage Celindra in the City of Dalaran.

92460.name: Coming of Age
objectivesText: Speak with Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.

92461.name: Harmony in Balance
objectivesText: Slay 8 Vuldren Juveniles in Thendal Grove.

92462.name: Infestation Investigation
objectivesText: Slay 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove.

92463.name: The Cirrusfly Queen
objectivesText: Destroy the Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove.

92464.name: Elemental Unrest
objectivesText: Speak to Yala Windwatcher in Thendal Grove.

92465.name: Agitators
objectivesText: Slay 6 Roiling Winds and 7 Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.

92469.name: Return to Rorian
objectivesText: Bring word of the Al'Aketh to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Grove.

92470.name: Foul Matriarch
objectivesText: Slay 8 Ursera Scavengers and collect the head of the den mother, Urs'anah in Thendal Grove.

92471.name: Aetheen of the Gales
objectivesText: Speak with Aetheen of the Gales in Thendal Grove.

92472.name: The Next Step
objectivesText: Report to Constable Aonda in Shen'dar Village.

92473.name: Aggressive Encroachment
objectivesText: Collect 6 Scrawny Ursera Claws from Scrawny Ursera in Thendal Grove.

92474.name: Falling With Style
objectivesText: Jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall.

92479.name: A Scribbled Letter
objectivesText: Read the Scribbled Letter and speak to Tordrin Stemblade in Northshire Abbey.

92481.name: A Student of the Arcane
objectivesText: Examine the Glowing Recall Crystal, then speak with Dorii Brightwhisper in Thendal Grove.

92482.name: The Way of the Hunter
objectivesText: Read the Scribbled Note and then speak with Tai'ree Farsight in Thendal Grove.

92483.name: At Home in the Shadows
objectivesText: Read the Simple Note then speak with Akeri Duskblade within the watchtower in Thendal Grove.

92485.name: A Student of Nature
objectivesText: Read the Folded Parchment then speak with Xyton Silverwind in Thendal Grove.

92489.name: Power Overwhelming
objectivesText: Slay the Mana Elemental in the City of Dalaran for High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind City.

92500.name: A Bit of the Sky
objectivesText: Find the Jewel of the Horizon in the Wormwing harpy nests on Mount Hyjal and bring it to Ketharas.

92515.name: The Problem With Prideclaws
objectivesText: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.

92516.name: Hippogryph Harassment
objectivesText: Slay 8 Hippogryph Youths, 6 Hippogryph Protectors and a Hippogryph Matriarch in the Shen'dar Highlands.

92517.name: The Criminal Element
objectivesText: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.

92528.name: Among the Faithful
objectivesText: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.

92529.name: Falaath Village
objectivesText: Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.
If you lose your Mark of Akir, speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village to regain the effect.

92532.name: The Warrior's Path
objectivesText: Read the Crumpled Note you've been given, then seek out Blademaster Ren inside the Thendal Village watchtower.

92533.name: Twisted Tools
objectivesText: Recover a Wicked Ritualist's Kris and a Recoiling Gnarlybark Staff from Blackthorne cultists.

92544.name: Al'Aketh Thugs
objectivesText: Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.

92550.name: Havoc in the Highlands
objectivesText: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.

92551.name: Stolen Supplies
objectivesText: Collect 10 packs of Stolen Shen'dar Supplies from Falaath Village in the Shen'dar Highlands.

92553.name: Restocking the Larders
objectivesText: Collect 3 Small Eggs and 8 Strider Meat from creatures found throughout the Shen'dar Highlands.

92591.name: Final Death
objectivesText: Use the Survivor's Torch on the Bone Pile, then collect the Reanimator's Amulet.

92593.name: Avalanche of Corruption
objectivesText: Enter Dae'gun and locate a high vantage point, then report details to Johun.

92594.name: Kindling, Kinda
objectivesText: Destroy 15 Tainted Shrubbery for Kaylaena Springwhisper at the workshop in the Tainted Foothills.

92596.name: The High Order
objectivesText: Have a seat and speak with Rathiril Sunlance.

92597.name: Reading the Leylines
objectivesText: Use your Read Leyline racial ability at the leyline in Thendal Grove.

92612.name: Aid from Moonglade
objectivesText: Travel to Nighthaven, in Moonglade, and ask Dendrite Starblaze for assistance on Ketharas' behalf.

92640.name: Desperate Times
objectivesText: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar and follow her instructions.

92642.name: Disrupting Logistics
objectivesText: Slay 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands.

92643.name: The Turncoat
objectivesText: Find the cultist turncoat at the house just inside the highlands northwest of Valanaar.

92644.name: Unfortunate News
objectivesText: Deliver the glowing crystal to Talanaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

92645.name: Breaking the Breaker
objectivesText: Slay Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands.

92679.name: Blood Tithe
objectivesText: Listen to what Alvarion Windfield has to say and find Aamelia Windfield at the Windfield Orchard.

92682.name: Make Yourself Useful
objectivesText: Gather 10 Ripe Stormapples and slay 5 Hungry Bandits at the Windfield Orchard.

92683.name: Flutterfly Dust
objectivesText: Gather 5 Flutterfly Dust from the Flutterflies around the Gustberry Lowlands.

92684.name: Ornery Ornery Galestriders
objectivesText: Gather 7 Lowlands Galestrider Tenderloins from the Ornery Galestriders found throughout the Gustberry Lowlands.

92685.name: The Hills Have Eyes
objectivesText: Loot 7 Blood-Stained Bandit Masks from Highwayman Bandits in the Gustberry Lowlands.

92693.name: Standing Our Ground
objectivesText: Speak with Aamelia Windfield when you are ready to confront the bandit leader.

92698.name: What Is My Purpose?
objectivesText: Speak with Aamelia Windfield about the Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct.

92699.name: The Supreme Magister
objectivesText: Find Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar.

92701.name: To Valanaar
objectivesText: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.

92702.name: Branch Out
objectivesText: Locate a sturdy branch capable of reaching Fenwick Togglespring.

92703.name: Deliver the News
objectivesText: Speak with Alvarion Windfield in Valanaar.

92709.name: A Grand Adventure
objectivesText: Listen to what Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar has to say.

92727.name: The Missing Scholar
objectivesText: Discover what became of Fillion Flamebreeze.

92741.name: Unwelcome Visitors
objectivesText: Travel to Shadowgale Forest and collect 8 Shriekling Talons for Iaadaria Bitterwind in Valanaar.

92742.name: Testing the Wells
objectivesText: Use the Well Water Sample Kit to collect samples from the wells at the Jansen Stead and the Molsen Farm.

92743.name: A Conqueror's Crown
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and return a Conqueror's Crown from the Badlands to Warug in Magram Village.

92744.name: Murloc Gills
objectivesText: Alba Fairmoon wants you to collect 7 Longshore Murloc Gills along the shoreline of Westfall.

92745.name: The State of the Mines
objectivesText: Slay 4 Kobold Diggers in the Jangolode Mine and 6 Riverpaw Miners in the Gold Coast Quarry.

92747.name: Moonbrook Espionage
objectivesText: Collect 8 Suspicious Industrial Supplies from Moonbrook.

92748.name: Explosive Consultation
objectivesText: Travel to the Dwarven District in Stormwind and find an engineer who can help.

92749.name: A Dynamite Plan
objectivesText: Obtain 10 Rough Dynamite from crafting, trading, or the auction house, then return to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

92750.name: Detonation at a Distance
objectivesText: Talk to someone in Stormwind Intelligence about acquiring a remote detonator.

92751.name: Detonation at a Distance
objectivesText: Bring the Remote Detonator Kit to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

92752.name: Explosive Consultation
objectivesText: Return to Alba Fairmoon in Westfall.

92753.name: Destruction in Deadmines
objectivesText: Find the forge hidden in the Deadmines, and plant the Extra-Destructive Explosives nearby. Then, meet up with Alba Fairmoon at the Deadmines exit.

92754.name: A New Need for Shadow Protection
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Greater Shadow Protection Potions to Mirda in the Magram Village in Desolace.

92755.name: Mysterious Mysticism
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring 3 Greater Mystic Essences to Halea in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.

92814.name: I Need a Tailor
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a White Bandit Mask to Molkar in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.

92817.name: Leather Technique
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a Barbaric Harness to Talra in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.

92818.name: Big, No, MASSIVE Iron Axes
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 2 Massive Iron Axes to Grolkar in the Magram Village in Desolace.

92819.name: Destruction in Deadmines
objectivesText: Use the detonator.

92833.name: Ve'han's Fall
objectivesText: Use the Staff of the Mountain to strip Ve'han Talongrasp of his stolen power, then destroy him.

92834.name: Avenged Tenfold
objectivesText: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Windstone Charms from Al'Aketh cultists found north of Valanaar at the Gustberry Fields or Shrine of Akir.

92840.name: Catching Wind
objectivesText: Take the Index Esoteria to the Overlook Standing Stones in Shen'dar Highlands and use it on the Windstone Formations in the area to gather data.

92841.name: Valley of Bones
objectivesText: Improve your reputation with the Magram, and locate Orgrul near the Valley of Bones south of Magram Village.

92842.name: A Cousin Abroad
objectivesText: Find the missing cousin somewhere on Mount Hyjal.

92846.name: Outcast Necromancers
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and slay Outcast Necromancers within the Valley of Bones.

92849.name: The Missing Scholar
objectivesText: Keep searching for Fillion Flamebreeze.

92850.name: The Missing Scholar
objectivesText: Slay the Shriekling Matriarch in the Shriekling Den then return its head to Fillion Flamebreeze in Valanaar.

92858.name: WANTED: Ohk'zi
objectivesText: Bring the Staff of Ohk'zi to Latronicus Moonspear at Feathermoon Stronghold.

92859.name: Shroud of the Winter Wilds
objectivesText: Bring 5 Winterspring Chimaera Fur and 5 Winterspring Owl Feathers to Evie Whirlbrew.

92860.name: In Service of Zephras
objectivesText: Report to Valennia Stormfist and let her know that the High Order is with them in their fight against the Al'Aketh.

92867.name: Ground to Keep
objectivesText: Defeat the Boulderfist, Syndicate, and Witherbark intruders in Stromgarde Keep and return to Groundskeeper Lomar.

92872.name: Dutiful Steps
objectivesText: Throw the Pouch of Tomb Dust into The Great Sea and return to Caretaker Alaric in the Stromgarde Keep crypt.

92880.name: Return to Valanaar
objectivesText: Bring Yorna's Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.

92881.name: The High Elder's Request
objectivesText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

92909.name: Harvesting the Harvesters
objectivesText: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 14 Golem Isosprings and 5 Harvester Gyrostabilizers.

92910.name: Harvesting the Harvesters
objectivesText: Bring the Precessive Autocognition Assembly to Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm.

92911.name: Harvesting the Harvesters
objectivesText: Ozwin Ironsprocket at Saldean's Farm wants you to bring him 8 Golem Isosprings, 4 Copper Modulators, and a Crude Scope.

92914.name: Strange Pylons
objectivesText: Explore Shen'dralas in an effort to find other pylons like the one you found.

92947.name: Making Our Move
objectivesText: Slay 7 Al'Aketh Guardians, 7 Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and 7 Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.

92959.name: The Dying Ancients
objectivesText: Hunt down and destroy the corrupted ancient Sunderbark, then plant a seed in his remains.

92960.name: Siphoned Ephemeral Essence
objectivesText: Retrieve 6 Ephemeral Essences for Elaena Moonwhisper.

93016.name: A Brief History Lesson
objectivesText: Speak with Mordent Evenshade in Shen'dralas for information about the crystals you repaired.

93034.name: Valley of Bones
objectivesText: Improve your reputation with the Gelkis, and locate Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones far east of Gelkis Village.

93036.name: Infiltrating the Cult
objectivesText: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.

93041.name: Facing the Truth
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring an Accursed Skull and Gelkis Necromantic Garb to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.

93044.name: A Cleansing Cry
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring Tears of Theradras back to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.

93058.name: Saving Our Own
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis clan, and rescue 5 Gelkis Captives within the Valley of Bones. Return to Nerlokh near the entrance when you are done.

93065.name: Prepare for Battle
objectivesText: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.

93072.name: Long-Term Solutions
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram clan and slay 2 Outcast Scouts, 6 Outcast Marauders, and 8 Outcast Necromancers then return to Hagiak at the Magram Front.

93089.name: What Comes Next
objectivesText: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

93127.name: Summit Sentries
objectivesText: Reactivate the sentinel stones north, west, and south around the Blackthorne cultists.

93128.name: Khan Jehn
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and slay Khan Jhen at Magram Village. Once you have succeeded, report to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village in Desolace.

93129.name: Threat of Starvation
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 6 Stolen Supplies back to Hagiak at the Magram Front.

93159.name: The Strange Hermit
objectivesText: Speak with the Strange Hermit in the Shadowgale Forest and learn more about him.

93160.name: The Forest's Bounty
objectivesText: Gather 8 Shadowgale Acorns in Shadowgale Forest.

93161.name: The Ancient Hilt
objectivesText: Find someone who would be interested in the Ancient Hilt you found in the ruins of Ban'aethal.

93165.name: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears
objectivesText: Collect 5 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh cultists in Shadowgale Forest, the Shrine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands.

93172.name: Free the Hollows
objectivesText: Destroy 10 Wind Hollows in Shadowgale Forest.

93176.name: My Little Friends
objectivesText: Use the items contained in the Entomology Starter Kit to find and catch an Arbor Tarantula, Hay Weevil Specimen, and a Flesh Picker.

93188.name: Return to Orgrul
objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and report back to Orgrul near the northern entrance to Valley of Bones.

93197.name: Mending Communications
objectivesText: Take mail parcels from Sebelia at the summit camp on Mount Hyjal to Innkeeper Vizzie in Everlook.

93224.name: Carved Centaur Totems
objectivesText: Acquire 5 Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point.

93226.name: Buying Friendship: Magram
objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.

93227.name: Buying Friendship: Gelkis
objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Gelkis Quartermaster at Gelkis Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Gelkis Clan Centaur.

93269.name: Top of the Post
objectivesText: Take mail from Everlook up to Innkeeper Sebelia on the summit of Mount Hyjal.

93317.name: Crab Season
objectivesText: Collect 6 pieces of Windsong Crawler Meat.

93318.name: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable
objectivesText: Kill Vulgara the Insatiable in the Shen'dar Highlands and bring her head to Danarii Bellowveil.

93319.name: Pilfered Windstones
objectivesText: Collect 10 Pilfered Windstones from the Highlands Bandits in the Shen'dar Highlands.

93320.name: Tower Defense
objectivesText: Report to Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.

93341.name: Forlorn Gardens
objectivesText: Investigate the Forlorn Gardens near Shen'dralas and then return to Mithera at the nearby temple.

93362.name: What They've Done to My Peonies
objectivesText: Cull plants in the Forlorn Garden and then return to Mithera at Shen'dralas.

93383.name: Contents Under Pressure
objectivesText: Wait until you can safely open the Personal Survival Pack.

93394.name: Meeting the Magister
objectivesText: Locate Magister Kirandis inside the temple of Shen'dralas.

93404.name: Rot and Regret
objectivesText: Venture to Maraudon and recover a Vial of Earth Song Water and return it to Woodwyrd at the Forlorn Gardens in Desolace.

93406.name: Unfrozen Deliveries
objectivesText: Find 4 pieces of Missing Mail in the hills north of Everlook and bring it back to Innkeeper Vizzie.

93407.name: A Thorn in the Paw
objectivesText: Find thorn seeds in the forests at the summit of Mount Hyjal and bring them back to Tiala Whitemane.

93422.name: Blackthorne Blackout
objectivesText: Kill the Blackthorne Courier and confiscate her message.

93429.name: Blood of My Blood
objectivesText: Slay 10 Lost Ones in the Fallow Sanctuary.

93430.name: Taking the Bait Back
objectivesText: Find the Lost One Fisherman who stole Pelluk's lure, and take it back.

93443.name: Lost Shipping Crate
objectivesText: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

93444.name: Bait the Beast
objectivesText: Kill a Nightsaber Guardian, then bait out and kill Ghansurok using the Nightsaber Guardian haunch on the northern ridge of the summit.
Return with the heart of the chimaera.

93450.name: Phantasmal Problems
objectivesText: Take Vindael's unfinished sword and figure out a way to usher it into the spirit realm, then return the Phantasmal Blade to him at Shen'dralas.

93461.name: Welcome to Shen'dar Village
objectivesText: Speak with Rathiril Sunlance and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.

93464.name: The Visiting Mage
objectivesText: Find the mage in Desolace who knows about the power of draenethyst.

93465.name: Notes on Draenethyst
objectivesText: Take Gimashi's notes on Draenethyst, and bring them back to Azore Aldamort.

93510.name: Wake Memories
objectivesText: Find the anchor on Lake Everstill the War Veteran remembers from childhood.

93521.name: Challenger of the Gods
objectivesText: Take Ve'han's Research Notes to Tiala Whitemane.

93546.name: Spectral Iron Ore
objectivesText: Search for Spectral Iron Deposits around Shen'dralas and collect 10 Spectral Iron Ore. Return to Vindael in Shen'dralas once you have found enough.

93547.name: A Thorny Solution
objectivesText: Plant thorn seeds near the inn, the storage tower, and the grouping of trees at the loyalist druid camp.

93551.name: Praise
objectivesText: Use the Embroidered Scabbard to meet the Veteran of the Third War in Mount Hyjal near the broken cannon in Mourning's Rest.

93552.name: Harvesting Windstones
objectivesText: Collect 15 Windstone Clusters from Raw Windstones in Thendal Grove.

93567.name: Ends Meet
objectivesText: Allow the Veteran of the Third War to tell his story at the broken cannon in Mourning's Rest.

93568.name: Partially Digested Collar
objectivesText: Return the Partially Digested Collar to someone who knows about it. Presumably, they can be found in or near Shen'dralas in Desolace.

93572.name: To Serve The Draenei
objectivesText: Protect the draenei refugees as they pass through Kum'isha's rift to Outland. None of the refugees may die.

93574.name: Corpsefeeder's Carapace
objectivesText: Find someone interested in Corpsefeeder's Carapace.

93584.name: Cult Closure
objectivesText: Kill 10 Blackthorne Adepts and 10 Wild-branded Cultists.

93585.name: This Light of Mine
objectivesText: Escort Father Tuttle to The Harborage.

93594.name: Word of the Woods
objectivesText: Find Woodwyrd in the Forlorn Gardens at Shen'dralas in the Desolace.

93601.name: Passing the Blame
objectivesText: Seek out a quilboar of significance at the Bristleback Retreat.

93604.name: Agamaggan's Blood
objectivesText: Venture to Razorfen Downs and acquire Virulent Blood of Agamaggan, then return it to Kog'thug the Brave at Bristleback Retreat in the Desolace. Kog'thug felt it worth reminding that the Blood of Agamaggan inside Razorfen Kraul would not be sufficient.

93606.name: Not on Squealing Terms
objectivesText: Quell the quilboar's quarrel by bringing Quolga a Benevolent Bouquet and the Virulent Blood of Agamaggan. The flowers to make the bouquet can be acquired at the Forlorn Gardens, near Shen'dralas in the Desolace.

93609.name: Forlorn Necklace
objectivesText: Bring the Forlorn Necklace to Mithera at the temple of Shen'dralas in the Desolace.

93615.name: Kits and Cats
objectivesText: Find Shalla'kal's kittens in the wilds of Mount Hyjal.

93617.name: Prey and Predator
objectivesText: Dissuade stags from acting as predators.

93644.name: Tattered Journal
objectivesText: The text suggests the author of this journal may be somewhere in Shen'dralas.

93678.name: Abridged Notes on Draenethyst
objectivesText: Take Azore's transcribed notes back to Magtoor at the Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.

93679.name: Visions of Another
objectivesText: Watch Onku's vision with Magtoor.

93684.name: The Found One
objectivesText: Find the draenei searching for draenethyst in the Blasted Lands.

93685.name: To Serve Kum'isha
objectivesText: Find a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere in the Blasted Lands, and bring it to Kum'isha the Collector.
Be warned, this gem is one of the rarest crystals in all of Azeroth. Any creature in these lands could be holding a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere.

93686.name: Kum'isha's Endeavors
objectivesText: Find and return a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere to Kum'isha the Collector.

93747.name: Violence Into Verdure
objectivesText: Plant the Enchanted Seeds near the Ruined Ballista, the Ruined Catapult, and the Ruined Flying Machine.

93759.name: The Bounty of Nature
objectivesText: Collect 2 Hyjal Venison Cuts from untainted Hyjal Stags and 6 Scarlet Dart Tubers for the hermit's stew.

93773.name: The Pact
objectivesText: Report back Ketharas on Mount Hyjal.

93791.name: Speak with Belann
objectivesText: Speak with Belann Windwood in Valanaar.

93797.name: Boughs in the Wind
objectivesText: Bring a Wind-Infused Bough to Belann Windwood in Valanaar.

93825.name: Barkbound Blessings
objectivesText: Gather 12 clumps of Moonveil Moss and return to Suma Mossmane.

93826.name: Deal Dread to Deadwood
objectivesText: Defeat 8 Deadwood Totemics and 8 Deadwood Fel-Tenders and return to Elder Pinespeaker.

93827.name: Windswept Wards
objectivesText: Collect 16 Enchanted Harpy Amulet and return to Thobon Sapclaw.

93828.name: Herbs of the Hollow
objectivesText: Collect 10 Dried Hanging Herbs from around Barkskin Burrow and return them to Fennar Mossmane.

93830.name: Water of Hyjal
objectivesText: Fill a waterskin provided by Fennar Mossmane at the pond outside of the Deadwood Furbolg den.

93831.name: Sweetpaw Jam
objectivesText: Gather 30 Bear Berries from Hyjal and return to Osi Mistpaw.

93832.name: Shatter the Stonewatchers
objectivesText: Destroy 6 Eternal Sentry gargoyles in the destroyed Alliance base in upper Hyjal and return to Elder Mistpaw.

93833.name: Wicked Wisdom
objectivesText: Bring 5 owl bodies to Elder Pinespeaker in Barkskin Burrow in Hyjal.

93834.name: Burrow Beetles
objectivesText: Gather 10 Burrow Beetle Bits for Dala Fairmaw.

93835.name: Confront Lorthuna
objectivesText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.

93848.name: Work Well Done
objectivesText: Return to Ketharas and inform him of what occurred at the Summit of Eternity.

93926.name: The Western Watch
objectivesText: Find Peacekeeper Vaaniel at the western watchtower.

93927.name: A Last Request
objectivesText: Collect the note you found near the dead peacekeeper and read it to determine your next steps.

93928.name: Of Mice and Milk
objectivesText: Get the mouse a cookie.

93948.name: Deliver the Signet
objectivesText: Deliver the Shadowsong Family Signet to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

93949.name: Bugged
objectivesText: Kill Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated 8 Enchanted Skyhoppers.

93951.name: A Little Beauty
objectivesText: Collect 8 Hippogryph Down feathers in the Shen'dar Highlands.

93952.name: Balance Through Strength
objectivesText: Defeat 9 Deadwood Den Guardians and return to Brerufa.

93958.name: The Inner Sanctum
objectivesText: Speak with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir.

93963.name: Exploring the Alliance
objectivesText: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard, High Tinker Mekkatorque, and Tyrande Whisperwind.

94003.name: The Skybreaker Bulwark
objectivesText: Reclaim the Skybreaker Bulwark from Zaal Stormshield at the Shrine of Akir.

94004.name: Craftsman's Writ: Elixir of Ogre's Strength
objectivesText: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

94006.name: The Great Ursera Spirit
objectivesText: Speak with Urs'endris near the falls northeast of Valanaar.

94007.name: Taming the Beast
objectivesText: Report to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.

94013.name: Taming the Beast
objectivesText: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Vuldren Alpha in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.

94050.name: Training the Beast
objectivesText: Speak to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.
